description: A comprehension body whose final statement does not produce a value (`print :n`, a command call) raises ol-no-value at runtime (spec/execution-model.md:225), mirroring #114's checker shape at stage=semantic since execute() now runs check() before Phase 2. Issue #105. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
